name: Dimensity 9600 Pro
summary: MediaTek's 2 nm flagship for late-2026 phones (vivo X500 Pro, OPPO Find X10 Pro Max), with two Arm C2 Ultra cores at 4.55 GHz. MediaTek claims 17% faster single-core and 15% faster multi-core CPU than the Dimensity 9500; no independent results yet.

default.note: From Zing Gadget's report of MediaTek's China launch (2+3+3 core layout and clocks, TSMC 2 nm, performance claims).
